notes.title: MULTIPLAYER UPDATE
notes.content:
[h1]How To Access Multiplayer[/h1]
With crazy golf partys new update you can join a multiplayer lobby with upto 15 of your friends! This can be accessed from the main menu and hitting the multiplayer button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493064/0839d759c97bf27cd5ec0e8f00faaaa6d28fa4ac.png[/img]

[h1]Join Lobby Screen[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493064/08688c41764ba5e0c147452753817189eed3e200.png[/img]

[h1]Create Lobby Menu[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493064/ac2cfda874a517b73b0d95ebf81bc3df5f1f1435.png[/img]

Following these steps you will be able to access mutliplayer and play it with your friends if you havent already you can purchase the game down below as we are hold a sale until the 8th of march!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3524060/Crazy_Golf_Party/

notes.title: Golf Party Beta Test Update 0.0.2
notes.content:
[h1]Steam Cloud Saves[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493064/84b3525abe7835167cb56465a3df2c9e02413ea9.jpg[/img]

Steam Cloud saves have now been added to the game and usable as of version 0.0.2, This will save Graphics settings, Audio, Player Customisation settings and more!

[h2]Haunted Hallows Map is Complete[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493064/e5782f7bbda7e3b80f8227c7ff77871fec4224cf.png[/img]

The Haunted Hallows map is now complete and in this version of the build 0.0.2 this map features 9 Challenging holes for you to discover! Any Bugs or feedback to the app would be helpful and can be submitted through our discord linked below.

https://discord.gg/hTuX4KqFz8


[h2]Audio Menu[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493064/be01155fbcfd7cb42b678fb31be9dffb2529e6c5.png[/img]

An Audio Menu has now been added to the options menu this will allow you to control any sound within the games volume, The future plan is to add things like key binds and other Features that will improve the games overall accessibility.

Make sure you wishlist the game below to see when it releases as we will be doing a sale for the first week of release!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3524060/Crazy_Golf_Party/

notes.title: Golf Party Beta Test Update 0.0.1
notes.content:
[h1]New Map Update[/h1]

[b]Haunted Hallows[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493064/9f29ec804b1622571e71a3f26e0730f0e1f9b158.png[/img]

The game has received its new exciting new map Haunted Hallows, This map features 14 holes and new ways. This map will be 1 of the 5 maps that release on launch of the game. Along side (Funderheim, Egypt, Elden Forest and Amusement Park).

[b]Graphics Menu Added[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493064/f8235ec02ca4046ad470573d0535376c5edf5dd6.png[/img]

There has been a simple graphics menu added to the game as well in this new patch, in the next patch you will see updates the the customisation screen, level select and multiplayer menus along with video, audio and more getting added in order to make the game as user intuitive as possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493064/87834ad9e9894657927cb5fe19baea30bd469dbb.png[/img]

As always stay tuned from updates on the game, and wishlist now to know instantly when the game releases as we will be doing a sale on launch!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3524060/Crazy_Golf_Party/
